name: What is the difference between a full bathroom remodel and a cosmetic refresh?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a full bathroom remodel and a cosmetic refresh?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete bathroom remodel includes gutting the room down to the studs, reconfiguring or updating plumbing and electrical systems, and replacing all major elements. This scope involves installing new walk-in showers or bathtubs, custom tile, vanities, countertops, flooring, and ventilation fans. A cosmetic refresh typically keeps the existing footprint, plumbing locations, and layout intact, focusing instead on swapping out faucets, painting, installing a new mirror, or replacing cabinet hardware. Choosing a full renovation is usually necessary if you want to alter the layout, add built-in shower benches or niches, or resolve hidden moisture and subfloor damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full remodel updates the layout, plumbing, electrical, and fixtures down to the studs, while a cosmetic refresh only changes surface finishes like paint, mirrors, and hardware.
